emails.subject: A free 45-minute talk for your students: Your Brain vs AI
emails.body:
Dear Mental Wellbeing team,

I noticed Krea's 2026-27 Student Wellbeing Handbook, which links the health centre with your team and adds teleconsultations for students.

I give a free 45-minute online talk for students called "Your Brain vs AI": how attention and memory actually work, what leaning on AI does to thinking (based on published studies, stated honestly), and five simple habits that help with focus and memory during exams. There is no fee and nothing to buy; it is an awareness session with time for questions.

If it would be useful for your students this semester, reply with a date or two that suit you and I will make it work.

Warm regards,
Manish Kumar Singh
UnAI Labs | unai-labs.com

If you would rather not hear from me again, reply "no thanks" and I will not write again.
